title: Wavelet-Energy-Driven Dynamic Patching for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.21319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Patch-based transformers tokenise a time series into fixed-size, uniform windows, which commits the model to a single temporal resolution even though real signals are multi-scale. The discrete wavelet transform (DWT) is a natural alternative because it decomposes a signal across scales. A growing body of work makes the wavelet filter learnable, on the assumption that a more flexible wavelet forecasts better. That assumption has rarely been tested in isolation, because a single reported improvement usually credits three things at once. These are the use of any multi-resolution decomposition, the choice of wavelet and training the filter. We introduce a forecaster that turns a learnable-DWT per-scale energy map into variable-length patches by merging adjacent windows that share a dominant scale. Three findings follow. First, most of the improvement is there before any filter is learned. A frozen wavelet beats a fixed-patch baseline on eigh

translated_title: 基于小波能量驱动的动态分块时间序列预测方法
translated_abstract: 基于补丁的Transformer将时间序列标记为固定大小、均匀的窗口，这使得模型只能采用单一的时间分辨率，而真实世界的信号往往是多尺度的。离散小波变换（DWT）是一种天然的替代方案，因为它可以跨尺度对信号进行分解。目前越来越多的工作使小波滤波器变得可学习，其背后的假设是更灵活的小波能带来更好的预测效果。然而这一假设很少被单独验证，因为单次报告的性能提升通常同时归功于三个因素：使用了某种多分辨率分解、对小波的选择，以及对滤波器的训练。我们提出了一种预测器，它利用可学习DWT生成的逐尺度能量图，通过合并共享主导尺度的相邻窗口，将其转换为可变长度的补丁。由此我们得到三个发现：第一，大部分性能提升在任何滤波器被学习之前就已经存在，冻结的小波在八……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种将可学习离散小波变换的逐尺度能量图转化为可变长度补丁的动态分块时间序列预测方法，并发现大部分性能提升源于多分辨率分解本身而非可学习的小波滤波器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dynamic patching forecaster that converts a learnable-DWT per-scale energy map into variable-length patches for time series forecasting, and finds that most of the performance gain comes from multi-resolution decomposition itself rather than from learning the wavelet filter.
